jobs.name: water_column
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG water-effect layer for a cute pastel 2.5D chibi puzzle game. Hand drawn rounded clean contours in muted teal-blue, soft simple light-cyan shading, white water highlights, readable small scale. Cool refreshing WATER, not steam, wind, smoke, fire, or magic aura. No food, no characters, no container, no floor, no scene, no text, no frame, no glow/vignette/background haze. Truly transparent background. Fully isolated cutout with generous clear padding; no clipping. Palette pale sky blue #BDEDF4, aqua #70CDD9, muted teal outline #4D99AC, foam highlights #F3FDFF. Create one upright water jet COLUMN only. Portrait canvas aspect 1:2. A modest narrow stream rises vertically from lower center, slightly narrow base, three smoothly curving ribbon-like parallel streams that spread a little toward top, central channels with white highlights suggesting strong upward flow. Rounded water bulges along the edge, a few small elongated water droplets very close to jet. Top edge ends in a softly rounded open flaring neck ready to overlap a separate splash cap; DO NOT draw a huge canopy or mushroom cloud here. Center at x50%; stream extends from y90% to y12%, widest visible part no more than 55% canvas width. Gentle translucent aqua interior but readable solid watercolor surfaces. No horizontal baseline or puddle. This is the stem for a food fountain; food particles will be separate.

jobs.name: splash_cap
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG water-effect layer for a cute pastel 2.5D chibi puzzle game. Hand drawn rounded clean contours in muted teal-blue, soft simple light-cyan shading, white water highlights, readable small scale. Cool refreshing WATER, not steam, wind, smoke, fire, or magic aura. No food, no characters, no container, no floor, no scene, no text, no frame, no glow/vignette/background haze. Truly transparent background. Fully isolated cutout with generous clear padding; no clipping. Palette pale sky blue #BDEDF4, aqua #70CDD9, muted teal outline #4D99AC, foam highlights #F3FDFF. Create ONE wide low WATER SPLASH CROWN/CAP only. Landscape canvas aspect 2:1. At lower center a short turquoise neck enters upward and opens into a symmetrical but organic broad fan of plump rounded scalloped water lobes, like fluffy sea foam waves expanding left and right. Upper edge has clustered round cloud-like foam lobes but visibly WATER: blue-filled scallops, white glossy wet highlights and small water droplets curving outward from sides and above. The crown resembles a refreshing geyser's fan-shaped foamy water spray, not white smoke cloud. Connected broad aqua water mass underneath the rounded white/cyan foam ridges, two gentle curling lobes at lateral tips. No long vertical column below. Composition x10%-90%, y15%-85%; central neck reaches y90% at x50% to overlap separate rising water column. Cap is about twice as wide as high, full element contained in canvas. Food will bounce on top in-engine, do not include any food.
